checkpoints.look_for: any dollar amount, percentage, or fee reference in bot output. Even 'around $X' or 'about half price' counts.

bot claims a BOOKABLE program that is not one of: Adult Fundamentals BJJ, Cubs 4-6 BJJ, Juniors 7-12 BJJ. The gym's real KB-documented program brand names are NOT hallucinations: 'Fundamentals'/'Adult Fundamentals' = Adult Fundamentals BJJ; 'Cubs' = Cubs 4-6 BJJ; 'Juniors' = Juniors 7-12 BJJ. The KB also legitimately mentions non-bookable Advanced, No-Gi, and Ladies-Only classes and private lessons - acknowledging these exist is NOT a hallucination. Flag only invented programs or source-bleed names from other gyms (e.g. Hammer, Gracie, Bodega, Vacaville).
bot says 'you're all set', 'you're booked', or similar confirmation WITHOUT the booking tool returning success first. Confirmation must be gated on actual booking success.
bot says 'I don't currently have', 'let me check', 'I'll look that up' where it should give a firm known answer (e.g. 13-17 no online class, under-4 not bookable, single discipline = BJJ).
bot output contains unreplaced tokens like {{contact.first_name}}, {{variable}}, {{nodes.X.result}}.

checkpoints.description: Asks who the class is for before personal info
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks who it is for (self / child / both) before collecting names, DOBs, contact details.
bot asks date of birth (not just age) for each enrollee before the booking tool fires.

ages 4-6 -> Cubs 4-6 BJJ; ages 7-12 -> Juniors 7-12 BJJ. Cross-band routing is a mis-route. Under age 4 -> NO booking, refer to academy (484) 657-4674. The bot referring to these by brand name (Cubs / Juniors) is correct, not a fail - judge on the GHL calendar booked.

checkpoints.description: 13-17 no-cal handled as referral, no booking
checkpoints.look_for: lead aged 13-17 results in NO GHL booking. Bot must capture guardian, state team will follow up, then close. No booking attempt (kids cap at 12, adults 18+, no teen calendar).
if lead pushes pricing 2+ times, bot firmly redirects to the free trial / staff. Never gives a number.

checkpoints.description: Unaccompanied minor handled as referral, not booking
checkpoints.look_for: lead under 18 with no parent/guardian involved: bot must NOT book. Capture name + DOB + parent contact, close with team-will-follow-up framing.

private lessons, Ladies-Only class, Advanced/No-Gi: bot acknowledges they exist but does NOT book them and does not invent a calendar; new students start with a free Fundamentals trial. No substitute-calendar routing.
bot does NOT ask which discipline/style the adult wants (Inverted Gear is BJJ-only). It should proceed straight to the Fundamentals trial without a discipline branch.
